meta.title: MCP Market
meta.description: Browse the MCP market inside DSH and install, check, manage, update, edit or remove MCP connections.

title: MCP Market
subtitle: Install, check and manage MCP connections inside DSH.
search: Search name, description, category or tool…
emptyHint: Try a shorter keyword or another category.
emptyDetail: Select a server on the left to see details.
configHint: Replace <YOUR_...> placeholders after copying. Credentials stay local.
noRequired: This server has no required environment variables or headers.
noTools: The tool list has not been synced yet.
broken: Remote checks have failed repeatedly. Verify the service before use.
connectorHint: The MCP engine is built into this plugin. Refresh; if it stays empty, check that dsh-mcp-center is enabled.
backendMissing: MCP engine not ready. Restart DSH or check that dsh-mcp-center is enabled.
catalogUnavailableHint: Check your network, then refresh the catalog.
renameHint: Changes only the display name, not serverName, tool prefixes or connection identity.
backupNote: Exports redacted JSON; tokens, headers, environment, paths and OAuth grants are not exported.
restoreConfirm: Restore this snapshot? A failed connection rolls the whole restore back.
stateHint: Click Check to get the live status
installNativeHint: Enter credentials to create and validate a local MCP connection.
installHint: This DSH config was generated by the market. Replace <YOUR_...>, then import it.
argsHint: Replace any /path/to/... argument with a real path.
editHint: Edit the normalized JSON and save. Sensitive values can stay as <KEEP_EXISTING>.
editLoadFailed: Could not read the connection config
placeholderRemaining: Replace every <YOUR_...> placeholder first, or delete optional entries you do not need.
credentialMasked: The connector never returns plaintext tokens or keys to the page. This shows where they are stored and a mask; edit the JSON below to replace them.
credentialCopyNote: This copy is stored by the market plugin on this machine only.
credentialCopyMissing: This connection has no market copy yet (it may predate this feature). Enter it once below.
credentialCopyFormHint: This only saves the plugin's copy; it does not change the live connection.
credentialCopyEmpty: Enter at least one credential first
credentialCopyFailed: Could not save the credential copy
